item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

item.title: 20 minutes with the CEO of ElevenLabs, now reportedly valued at $22B
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: ElevenLabs powers the AI voice on the other end of a lot of customer service calls, and its CEO told me this week that businesses should probably tell you that — at least until getting a machine is what everyone expects anyway.

item.title: Meet the next wave of VCs judging Startup Battlefield 200 at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Meet the next wave of VCs judging the Startup Battlefield 200 contenders on the main stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register by September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT, to save up to $200 and to get a front-row seat to one of the most intense startup pitch competitions.

item.title: Google tests letting Gemini call businesses for you
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Google says the AI-calling feature will first be available to Pixel 11 owners in the U.S. who pay for a Gemini subscription.

item.title: Shield AI, Waabi, and General Motors on building AI when failure is not an option at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Leaders from Waabi, Shield AI, and General Motors join the Real World AI Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to talk building AI. Save up to $200 by September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Get a second pass at 50% off.

item.title: Lovable’s annualized revenue crosses $600M as vibe coding takes off
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Lovable co-founder Fabian Hedin said that apps created on the platform are getting nearly a billion monthly views each month.

item.title: Ando wants to take on Slack with a team messaging app that lets humans and agents work together
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Ando has raised $20 million in pre-seed and seed funding from investors including Accel, Index Ventures, and Emergence.

item.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Cal AI’s Zach Yadegari on how to create viral growth and capitalize on it
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Zach Yadegari joins the Builders Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to share how he capitalized on viral growth. Save up to $200 before September 25. Save 50% on a second pass.

item.description: Reason 4 of 5 to attend TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Practical answers. Two days left to save up to $200 on your pass. Savings disappear after September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Bring a second guest at 50% off.

item.title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta, Zack Whittaker
item.description: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.

item.title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec, Lucas Ropek
item.description: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.

item.title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: The tiny hardware device creates another mobile home for its AI agent Muse.

item.title: Meta introduces camera-free AI glasses
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta says the camera-free glasses will be lighter and have up to 12 hours of battery life.

item.title: Anthropic says its biology lab has already found something big
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: But maybe the biggest reveal is that Anthropic has not let Claude run loose in its biology lab. Humans are still, so far, in the loop.

item.title: Enveda secures $311M to bring more nature-derived AI drugs into clinical trials
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The round valued the AI biotech at $2 billion. It is currently testing drugs that treat skin conditions and preserve weight loss after stopping GLP-1s.

item.title: ChatGPT mobile app gets voice-based agentic features
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Pro and Plus users will be able to use the Work tab on their phones to complete agentic tasks.

item.title: Even Americans who use AI every day are worried about it
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: The report suggests that greater exposure will not resolve the unease around the technology, nor reduce public support for AI regulation.

item.title: YouTube Music gets more conversational with new AI features
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Built directly into the YouTube Music app, Ask Music lets users describe what they want to hear in everyday language rather than searching for individual songs or artists.

item.title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: YouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.

item.title: StrictlyVC at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Inside the changing rules of venture capital
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: StrictlyVC joins TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 to discuss the changing VC landscape thanks to AI. Get your Investor Pass to join these exclusive sessions. Save $200 before September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
